comment: EmulatR DS20 / PC264 platform device manifest (Tsunami 21272, dual EV6; boot uniprocessor with cpuCount=1). Created 2026-06-16. DS20 = PC264 lineage, the SAME platform family as the DS10/PC264 EmulatR already models -- it genuinely uses the Cypress CY82C693 south bridge, so this is the LOWEST-divergence second test after DS10 (firmware ds20_v7_3.exe or ds20_disk1/pc264srm.sys). Differences from DS10: dual-CPU capable (keep cpuCount=1 to avoid SRM secondary spin), DS20E uses DE500 at slot 9 / SCSI at slot 7 per REFERENCE_INDEX (slots here _PROVISIONAL/DS10-derived). The halt-button check is chipset-level (TIG smir). Strict JSON: no // or /* */ comments -- use comment fields.

iic_devices.name: iic_ocp0
iic_devices.comment: OCP LED panel (IIC_LED_TYPE @ 0x40, iic_driver.c). NOT the badge discriminator (corrected 2026-06-30): the OCP LED is present on BOTH AlphaPC 264DP and AlphaServer DS20. The real get_sysvar DS20 discriminator is iic_rcm_temp @ 0x9e (see below). Do NOT add iic_8574_ocp (0x4E) -> member 8 = DS20E/Goldrack.

iic_devices.name: iic_ocp1
iic_devices.comment: OCP data device (IIC_LED_TYPE @ 0x42). The OCP is a control+data PAIR: ocp0 (0x40)=control, ocp1 (0x42)=data (sable_ocp_driver.c). sable_ocp_init opens BOTH; presenting only ocp0 caused 'Device Open Error: IIC_OCP1' + sable_ocp_init exit status 1 (non-fatal).

iic_devices.name: iic_rcm_temp
iic_devices.comment: KCRCM server-management-card temperature sensor (IIC_LED_TYPE @ 0x9e, iic_driver.c:264). THIS is the get_sysvar (pc264.c:636) DS20 discriminator -- 'only present on the AlphaServer DS20' per source comment. fopen(iic_rcm_temp) success -> get_sysvar returns SYSVAR member 6 -> banner 'AlphaServer DS20'; absent (node 0x9e NAK) -> member 1 = 'AlphaPC 264DP'. Root-caused 2026-06-30 by retire-trace of get_sysvar. byte 0x19 (~25C) is cosmetic; registration gates on the read succeeding, not the value.

pci_irq_table_comment: BOARD DATA (JRN-SCSI-003): PCI INTx -> Cchip DRIR routing, VERBATIM from the console's own pci_irq_table (apisrm pc264_io.c:727, PChip 0 row). Index = (slot-5)*4 + (pin-1); slots 5..10; value = DRIR bit, 255 = not routed (Cypress bridge ISA special-case). Slot 6 rows are the real Goldrush embedded Adaptec SCSI; slots 7-9 = option slots. Consumed by Machine -> setScsiIntxRouting (S3 generalizes to all option cards).

pci_devices.name: cypress_ide
pci_devices.comment: Cypress 82C693 IDE func1 (genuine for PC264/DS20). Fixed legacy ports; no relocatable BARs. Console name field is 100*func+slot -> 105 (real-hardware convention, proven by the DS10 golden: pga0.0.0.16.0 func0 vs pgb0.0.0.116.0 func1); devices are dqa<unit>.<unit>.<chan>.105.0. A storage row below MEANS THE DEVICE EXISTS (same rule the pka comment states); a row with empty media does NOT enumerate, so do not leave one parked. To repopulate dqa0, ADD a row: channel 0, unit 0, type ata_disk, media <file>. Only channel 0 is declared, so the console reports dqa alone -- real hardware reports dqa AND dqb (JRN-SCSI-008 item 3); the engine already decodes both port ranges (AtaTaskfileEngine kPriCmdBase 0x1F0 / kSecCmdBase 0x170).

storage.comment: primary slave = dqa1, ATAPI CD. media empty = no disc loaded.

pci_devices.name: de500_tulip
pci_devices.comment: On-board DE500-AA (DECchip 21143 tulip). DS20E places it at slot 9; slot here _PROVISIONAL.

pci_devices.name: pka_53c810
pci_devices.comment: NCR 53C810 SCSI HBA (KZPAA lineage) -> console pka0 + dka disks (JRN-SCSI-001). Bind row: apisrm io_device_list.h 0x00011000 -> n810/pk/PKE; the DS20 v7.3-2 console carries the pke driver (verified live). Slot 8 = minimal-churn placement (Q2: DS20E-faithful slot-7 shuffle deferred). MANIFEST-PINNED (2026-07-25): a disk target EXISTS on the bus only for a storage row below; undeclared ids selection-timeout. unit = SCSI target id 0..6; id 7 = the HBA itself (dka7.img in vStorage cannot attach). SRM unit naming: dka<id*100+lun> -> id 0 = dka0, id 1 = dka100, id 2 = dka200, ...

storage.comment: SCSI id 0 -> dka0: THE VMS system disk (moved from IDE dqa0; the P3 NOIOVEC retest target -- b dka0).
